RESY App

Source: vignettes/articles/app.Rmd
app.Rmd

Classify your plots with EUNIS-ESy or your own expert system, then explore the rules behind each assignment. RESY runs directly in your browser through webR. Your files are read inside this browser tab and are not uploaded anywhere.

Data

The files below are the example data shipped with RESY: 200 plots from Tuscany with 3,580 species records. Choose your own files to replace them. Files can be comma, semicolon or tab separated and of any size, such as a full EVA export; RESY reads them in parts.
